tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Shape Operators of Spheres] ↗ prop:existence-local-defining-functions 1. ch8:8.25

For $F(x)=|x|^2$, the outward unit normal on $S^n(R)$ is \[ N=\frac1R\sum _{i=1}^{n+1}x^i\partial _i. \] Therefore \[ sX=-\frac1R\sum _{i,j=1}^{n+1}X^j(\partial _jx^i)\partial _i =-\frac1RX. \] Thus every principal curvature and the mean curvature equal $-1/R$, while the Gaussian curvature is $(-1/R)^n$ for this orientation. \end{example}

For a parametrized surface in $\mathbb R^3$, a unit normal is \begin{equation} N=\frac{X_1\times X_2}{|X_1\times X_2|}. \tag {8.26} \end{equation}
